title: A New and Efficient Synthesis of the HMG‐CoA Reductase Inhibitor Pitavastatin

sections.abstract: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title><jats:p>A new synthetic method for the preparation of pitavastatin is described. The approach circumvents various synthetic problems associated with the buildup of the 3,5‐dihydroxy‐C<jats:sub>7</jats:sub> acid side chain of HMG‐CoA reductase inhibitors (statins). The use of the C<jats:sub>6</jats:sub>‐amide derivative <jats:bold>5</jats:bold> instead of ester derivatives in the coupling reaction with carboxaldehyde <jats:bold>8</jats:bold> (<jats:italic>Scheme 3</jats:italic>) prevents undesired side reactions, such as eliminations and <jats:italic>retro</jats:italic>‐aldol reactions. The method provides synthetic statins, such as pitavastatin, in >99% ee and exceptionally high overall yield. The enantiomerically pure starting material, (3<jats:italic>S</jats:italic>)‐3‐{[(<jats:italic>tert</jats:italic>‐butyl)dimethylsilyl]oxy}‐5‐oxo‐5‐{[(1<jats:italic>S</jats:italic>)‐1‐phenylethyl]amino}pentanoic acid (<jats:bold>3c</jats:bold>), is prepared by an improved procedure from 3‐{[(<jats:italic>tert</jats:italic>‐butyl)dimethylsilyl]oxy}glutaric anhydride (<jats:bold>1</jats:bold>) and (1<jats:italic>S</jats:italic>)‐1‐phenylethylamine (<jats:bold>2c</jats:bold>; <jats:italic>Scheme 1</jats:italic>).</jats:p>
